title: Eight Trigrams Three Hundred Sixty-One Palms
body:
Syntax: perform eight trigrams three hundred sixty-one palms [target]

Minimum level 95, Byakugan mastery 82% and inherited Potential 80 or higher. This is a clan-exclusive Gentle Fist technique, dealing damage to the opponent and targeting chakra/stamina pathways. Successful hits may seal tenketsu briefly, stopping jutsu use. See 'help hyuga' for full bloodline rules. A technique only becomes available when level, mastery, and the character's permanent bloodline potential all qualify.
